tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search published Spot pages and Spot's insurance research: industry pillars, vertical insurance guides and FAQs, provider profiles, comparisons, best-of provider rankings by coverage line and business type, provider reviews, Reliability Scores, rankings, and rating methodology, with deterministic le

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Retrieve a complete published Spot page by canonical path or URL, including /industries, industry pillars and vertical guides at /industries/{slug}, their FAQs at /industries/{slug}/{question}, provider profiles, comparisons, best-of rankings at /best, /best/{line} and /best/{line}/{segment}, review

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Retrieve a published, sourced provider comparison. Provider aliases and reversed ordering resolve to the one canonical comparison. Optional coverage (for example "cyber", "D&O" or "workers comp") also lists each provider's published offering page for that line; per-coverage line comparisons are reti

tools.name: get_provider_score
tools.description: Retrieve a published reliability assessment and Reliability Score for one provider. Provider aliases resolve to the canonical assessment. This is an editorial score for a stated role and scope, not an AM Best rating or a recommendation. Optional need runs a bounded editorial judgment over that asses

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Retrieve the current published Reliability Score rankings. Broker scores and Carrier & MGA scores are ranked separately; the directory also shows a combined score, the average of the two. Partial scores and unrated assessments keep their qualifications. Use search_provider_reliability for provider,

tools.name: search_provider_reviews
tools.description: Search published provider reviews by query, Review Score range, and rating availability; sort alphabetically or by displayed Review Score. Scores equally weight eligible source ratings on a 10-point scale and use an approximate academic conversion for BBB grades. Use get_provider_reviews for source-

tools.name: get_provider_reviews
tools.description: Resolve a provider name, alias, or slug and retrieve its published review summary, Review Score contributors, original source metrics, qualifications, and full Markdown with citations. Unpublished or unavailable review records return found:false.

tools.name: search_provider_reliability
tools.description: Search published Reliability Score assessments by query, status, and score range, and sort by name or displayed score. rubric=all sorts and filters by the combined score (the average of the Broker and Carrier & MGA scores, or the one a provider has).

tools.name: ask_spot
tools.description: Generate a bounded answer from retrieved public evidence. Every readable factual statement is copied from validated evidence and linked to its source.
